An entity id does not match `<format>:<scope>:<kind>#<key>`, or is not
globally unique. A native validator reports a duplicated, unowned, or
uncovered source-native identity here as well.

A PMI target, datum reference, datum system, or semantic-annotation
reference does not resolve.

A presentation-layer item does not resolve, or an appearance texture
mapping or bump map carries a non-finite value.
An arena is not strictly sorted by entity id.

A reference between entities is defective: a typed reference or id does
not resolve; an entity belongs to another owner or sketch; a dependency
or referenced feature does not precede its consumer, or the consumer
omits it from its dependencies; references form a cycle; an identity,
ordinal, address, or range is repeated or invalid; a constraint's
operands are not the kinds the constraint states; a configuration state
disagrees with the feature states it closes over; an entity schema
cannot state its typed references; or an occurrence places the root
definition.

A coedge radial ring does not close, crosses edges, or, with two
members, states equal coedge senses.

Wire topology ownership is violated: a coedge also references a wire
edge, an edge also references a free vertex, a wire edge or free vertex
does not belong to exactly one shell, or a wire body contains faces.
A face-bearing shell is disconnected through shared edges or vertices.

A surface, curve, pcurve, or point carrier is orphan: no topology or
retained construction data reaches it.

An annotation provenance or exactness key does not resolve to an entity,
an exactness field path does not resolve, or an entity cannot be
serialized to check its field paths.

A source-native link is defective: a `native_ref` or native-record link
does not resolve, or a link list is not an array of identity strings. A
codec's native validator also reports here a native record whose frame,
arena census, ordinal run, ownership, or identity disagrees with the
source container.

A parameter range is outside its carrier's canonical domain: an edge
range, a coedge use-curve range, or a coedge pcurve range; or a spatial
sketch NURBS surface states a zero degree.

A document-wide or per-entity tolerance is outside a sane canonical
range.

Preserved bytes do not account for their source: a ledger entry, owner,
or boundary is invalid, a nonempty entry is missing, ranges overlap or
leave a gap, a coverage report is stale or does not prove exact closure,
a preservation record disagrees with the authoritative bytes, or a
carrier census disagrees with the parsed payloads.
A tessellation references a missing body, face, or texture asset.

Geometry disagrees with what it supports, or a feature's geometric
inputs are inconsistent: an edge curve, a coedge use-curve, or a pcurve
mapped through its face surface misses the vertex positions it must
meet; a procedural curve does not evaluate at its endpoints or misses
its endpoint or offset-distance contract; a sketch profile is
disconnected, or a sketch constraint, offset pair, locus, or projected
copy has no consistent solution; a feature reference does not name the
kind of geometry it must name, or does not precede its consumer; a
generated vertex, edge, face, body, profile, or region selection is
empty, repeated, out of range, or owned by another sketch; or a
configuration parameter, sheet-metal height, or scale transform is not a
usable value.

A count or multiplicity is internally inconsistent: a parameter name or
ordinal repeats within its scope, a design repeats a configuration
ordinal, configuration source index, or feature ordinal, a design states
more than one active configuration, a feature states more than one input
or result topology state, a sketch constraint states the wrong number of
members, a native record census disagrees with the source container, or
a document states more than one root definition, or a complete decoded
document none.

A face's edge loop does not list its coedges in traversal order: its
coedges form one closed traversal by vertex identity in another order,
several closed traversals, or none.

A coedge does not list its pcurve uses in traversal order: they form
one chain from the coedge's end to its start.

A face's sense disagrees with the winding of its loops, or the faces
of a body whose shells are closed disagree on its volume: a face's
readings or a shell's volume sign contradict the body's orientation,
or the flux of the unit field through the shells exceeds its
tolerance.

The measurement findings pass ran out of its allowance before it
checked every face, edge and closed body for [`Self::RingOrder`],
[`Self::PcurveOrder`] and [`Self::Orientation`].

A quantity that the source declares for its bodies differs from the
quantity measured on the decoded geometry by more than the
measurement's error terms, cannot be measured, or names no bodies.

A record of the design layer breaks a rule of part 10 of the CADIR
v11 specification: a scope invariant, the container tree, a position,
an evaluation key or base, a current state, a resolved state, or a
configuration, arrangement, or override.

A record of the process layer breaks a rule of part 10 of the CADIR
v11 specification: an operation's setup membership, a step, a
reference between process records, a toolpath or process state key,
a binding, or a setting stated off its operation's class.

DialectId.description:
A registry dialect id, for example `"rhino:archive-80"`.

Canonical form is `<format>:<name>`. The format contains lowercase ASCII
letters and digits. The name also admits dots and hyphens, but a hyphen
cannot be first or last. Outside the owning codec the validated id is an
opaque label.

Serializes and deserializes as the plain string. Read it with
[`DialectId::as_str`] or print it; there is no other access to the raw
string.

DialectLayers.description:
A report's primary format layer and any nested or carried format layers.

Extra layers are unique by `(format, instance)`. An extra layer for the
primary format has an instance that identifies it inside the containing
document. The wire names the primary explicitly, so the collection carries
its complete identity without an enclosing report's format.

A read rejects a wire whose `extra` repeats a `(format, instance)` key, and
one whose `extra` carries the primary key. The key set on the wire is the
key set of the value, so no layer is silently discarded or overwritten.

DialectMatch.description:
One format layer's identification of one document.

A document carries several format layers: `.sldprt` contains Parasolid;
`.f3d`, `.ipt`, and SAT contain ACIS; NX contains Parasolid and JT. One
match describes one layer.

declared.description:
Version fields the source declared, verbatim, under keys pinned per
codec in the registry.

Declarations are evidence, never a control input: the dialect is what
the bytes obey, not what they declare.

instance.description:
Instance of this format layer inside the containing document.

`None` when the layer occurs once or has no report-local identity. This
is not source-declared evidence and therefore does not belong in
[`Self::declared`].

bodies.description:
The bodies the feature contributes, whose records are in the state
after the feature. `None` states that the source stores no
separate geometry for the feature.

tessellations.description: The tessellations a mesh import contributes.

oneOf.description: An operation known without its operands.
An operation whose meaning is not established.

native_options.description: Options whose meaning is not established.

source_settings.description: Options with no design meaning.

FeaturePolyline.description: A finite feature polyline with distinct adjacent vertices and sufficient vertices for closure.

closed.description: Whether the last vertex connects to the first.

FeatureResultTopology.description:
Persistent feature-local topology identities in one regenerated result.

These identities describe intermediate history results that need not be
members of the saved current model topology. Generated feature selections
address members through the producing feature and the corresponding local
identity.

members.description: Feature-local identities in stable source order, tagged by arena.

native_ref.description: Full-fidelity source state reference.

FeatureRigidPlacement.description: A finite right-handed rigid feature placement.

FeatureRowWire.description:
One row of the model route's feature list.

`regeneration_parent` is a model-route datum: the read hands it to
[`crate::document::Model`] with the feature, which is the only owner that
can place the edge. The standalone route reads [`FeatureReadWire`], which
declares no such field, so the difference between the two routes is a
field, not a check.

FeatureSourceContent.description: One item in a source feature's mixed-content sequence.

oneOf.description: Literal text between child records.
Dimension or equation parameter at this position.
Nested feature record at this position.

FeatureStateOverride.description:
A configuration's state of one feature. It states at least one of its
fields.

definition.description:
The feature's definition in this configuration: a structural
difference.

suppressed.description: Whether the feature is suppressed in this configuration.

FeatureSupportPlaneFrame.description: A resolved support-plane frame whose relative orthogonality bound scales each norm in order.

FeatureTreeNodeRole.description: Canonical role of a non-modeling feature-tree node.

oneOf.description: Annotation container.
Ambient scene light.
Comment container.
Cross-section container.
Design-binder container.
Detail-item container.
Profile-selection handle generated from a dissectable sketch.
Directional scene light.
Equation container.
Exploded-view container.
Favorites container.
User-created feature folder.
Generic history folder.
Lights, cameras, and scene container.
Markup container.
Built-in model origin node.
Point scene light.
Material container or assignment node.
Note container.
Selection-set container.
Sensor container.
Built-in sheet-metal state root.
Solid-body container.
Spot scene light.
Surface-body container.
Table container.

FeatureUnitPlaneFrame.description: A finite origin and two perpendicular unit directions.

Feed.description: A finite linear feed in millimetres per second.

FeedRate.description: A feed: per time, per spindle revolution, or per tooth.

oneOf.description: A feed per time.
A feed per spindle revolution.
A feed per tooth.
The cutting feed.
The plunge feed.
The ramp feed.
The feed into the cut.
The feed out of the cut.
The retract feed.
The approach feed.
The departure feed.

The feed of a direct link between passes that keeps the cutting
level.

The feed of a link that may leave the cutting level. A technology
that states none feeds those links at its `Cutting` feed.
The feed of the finishing movement class.
The feed of the reduced movement class.
A role that no arm states, by the source's name.

FilledSurfaceBoundaryCondition.description: One filled-surface boundary condition and its continuity weight.

oneOf.description: Positional continuity, which has no weight.
First-derivative continuity with an optional resolved weight.

weight.description: Positive dimensionless weight; absent when the source weight is unresolved.

oneOf.description: Second-derivative continuity with an optional resolved weight.

weight.description: Positive dimensionless weight; absent when the source weight is unresolved.

FilledSurfaceContinuity.description:
Resolved continuity conditions for a filled-surface boundary.

One condition per boundary component, in source order. A boundary whose
components all impose the same condition is uniform, which [`Self::uniform`]
reports; a uniform boundary has no second spelling to disagree with.

FilledSurfaceContinuityState.description:
Optional filled-surface continuity.

The wire carries the component conditions and nothing else, so an aggregate
condition that disagrees with them is unrepresentable.

Fillet.description:
Rounds edges or blends between face sets. A fillet holds one or more
sets, each with its own size and profile.

native_options.description:
Source options whose meaning is not established, and the values of
typed facts whose carrier is unread.

sets.description: The sets, each with its own size and profile.

source_settings.description: Source options with no design meaning.

FilletGroup.description: One independently dimensioned group of filleted edges.

FilletProfile.description: The cross-section shape of a fillet set.

oneOf.description: A circular section.
A conic section sized by its shape.
A curvature-continuous (G2) section.

shape.description: The source's shape factor of the section, from 0 to 0.95.

oneOf.description: A source section whose meaning is not established.

FilletSection.description: The cross-section of a fillet set.

weight.description:
The source's tangency weight of the section, whatever its profile. A
weight other than 1 makes the section non-circular.

oneOf.description: Rounds the edges the selection reaches, in source order.

hold.description:
The hold lines that bound the blend on each side, where the source
states them: the first on the side whose face loop traverses the
edge in the edge's own direction, the second on the other.

spine.description: The spine that orients the cross-sections.

oneOf.description: Rounds between two face sets.

near.description: The help point that chooses among solutions.

spine.description: The spine that orients the cross-sections.

trim.description: Whether the support faces are trimmed to the blend.

oneOf.description: Replaces a center face set by a blend tangent to the two side sets.

center.description: The center faces the blend replaces.

FilletSize.description: The size of a fillet set.

oneOf.description: A constant rolling-ball radius.
A constant chord width between the support boundaries.

Distinct setbacks on the two supports. `first` lies on the face whose
loop traverses the edge in the edge's own direction for an edge set,
and on the first face set for a face set.

first.description: The setback on the first support.

second.description: The setback on the second support.

oneOf.description: A radius by stations along the set's chain.
The hold lines alone fix the width.
The conic profile alone fixes the width.

A size form whose meaning is not established. The rest of the round
stays typed.

FinishingSteps.description: Finishing levels or passes: `count` of them, `step` apart.

FinitePoint2.description: A parameter-space point with finite coordinates.

FinitePoint3.description: A model-space point with finite coordinates.

FiniteVector3.description: A displacement with finite components, including zero.

FitDeviations.description:
A fit's stored deviations: the designation's published cell (a cache),
the source's own where they differ from it, or deviations no table the
decoder holds checks.

oneOf.description:
The designation's cell at the nominal in a published table the decoder
holds.
The source's own deviations, which differ from that cell.

Deviations of a designation whose standard's table the decoder does
not hold.

FitStandard.description: The standard whose table defines a limits-and-fits designation.

oneOf.description: ISO 286.
ANSI B4.1.
Any other standard's name, as the source spells it.

FitZone.description: The feature a limits-and-fits designation applies to.

oneOf.description: A hole.
A shaft.

Flange.description: A wall grown from sheet edges.

angle.description:
The bend's sweep: the angle the wall turns through from the plane of the
face the edge bounds.

height_datum.description:
The line a `Distance` height is measured from. It decides how the height
is read.

outline.description:
The wall's outline, an open chain sketched in the wall's own plane, on
the face `height_datum` names, its two free ends on that sharp. It gives
the wall's height, width, and sweep, so a flange with an outline states
none of the three, on its one edge.

position.description: Where the bend lies against the selected edge.

rule.description: The sheet-metal rule the feature names, where the source names one.

width.description: The wall's extent along each edge.

oneOf.description: A distance from the height datum.
Up to a target.

offset.description: The offset from the target.

target.description: The target.

FlangeMeasure.description: Where the two flange lengths of a bend deduction or compensation run to.

oneOf.description: The intersection of the two outer faces, at every deflection.

That intersection up to a deflection of 90°, and above it, for each
flange, the plane tangent to the bend's outer face and perpendicular to
that flange: a setback of the inside radius plus the thickness.

FlangeWidth.description: The extent of a flange along its edge.

oneOf.description: The edge's length.
A width centred on the edge's midpoint.

The part of the edge left `first` in from its start and `second` in from
its end.

`width` of the edge's line, starting `offset` from the point `from` and
running in the edge's direction, or ending there and running against it
where `reversed`; it may run past the edge's end.

offset.description: The offset from the point.

reversed.description:
Whether the width ends at the offset point and runs against the
edge's direction.

oneOf.description: One pair of setbacks per selected edge, in edge order.

One width per selected edge, in edge order, each centred on that edge's
midpoint.

Flex.description:
A deformation of bodies between two trim planes normal to the z axis of
`frame`, which changes only the region between them.

native_options.description:
Source options whose meaning is not established, and the values of
typed facts whose carrier is unread.

source_settings.description: Source options with no design meaning.

trims.description:
How far each trim plane moves inward from the bodies' extent along the
z axis.

FlexForm.description: Structural form of a flex deformation.

oneOf.description: Angular bending.
Angular twisting.
Transverse tapering.
Axial stretching.

Bends about the frame's x axis with its neutral plane the frame's xz
plane, keeping the arc length between the trim planes along that
plane, so that length is `angle` times the bend radius.

radius.description:
The bend radius: a cache of the angle and the arc length, where
the source stores it.

oneOf.description: Turns about the z axis by `angle`.
Tapers along the z axis by `factor`.
Stretches along the z axis by `distance`.

distance.description: The distance.

oneOf.description: A deformation whose meaning is not established.

FlexMode.description:
Deformation applied by a flex feature.

Each resolved arm carries the one magnitude its family needs, and the
unresolved arm carries no magnitude at all, so a magnitude beside an
unresolved family has no spelling.

oneOf.description: Deformation family whose required magnitude remains unresolved.

form.description: Deformation family, when the source named one.

oneOf.description: Bend through a signed angle.
Twist through a signed angle.
Scale transverse sections by a dimensionless factor.
Extend or contract along the flex axis.

distance.description: Signed change in length.

Folder.description:
A display grouping of a contiguous run of an ordered container's members,
`first` to `last` by index. It scopes no state, has no position, and has
no rollback. Folders of one container nest or are disjoint.

first.description: The index of the first member of the run.

last.description: The index of the last member of the run.

Form.description:
A subdivision form. Its control cages are its definition, not a state; its
B-rep evaluation is the state after the feature, with the limit-surface
carriers.

cage.description: The control cages, as a topology that holds subdivision records only.

native_options.description: Source options whose effect is not established.

source_settings.description: Source options that select how the source computes the result.

FormatIdentity.description:
A format identity that is either classified by a typed payload or retains
only its known format.

Classified state stores no second format string. The payload is the one
author of its namespace, so the format is on the wire exactly once in
either state.

oneOf.description: The payload carries the complete classified identity.

dialects.description: Classified payload, whose namespace is the format.

oneOf.description: The format is known but no classification payload exists.

Fraction.description: A finite fraction in the closed interval from zero to one.

Fragment.description: One fragment of a curve that its neighbours cut into pieces.

oneOf.description: The X axis.
The Y axis.
The Z axis.

FrameAxis2.description: An axis of a connector frame.

oneOf.description: The x axis.
The y axis.
The z axis.

FullRoundFilletGroup.description: One full-round fillet group with pairwise disjoint face selections.

FullRoundSideSelection.description: One side of a full-round fillet.

oneOf.description: The kernel infers this side from the center-face selection.
Explicit side-face selection.
A side-face selection exists but cannot be resolved.

FunctionStep.description:
A step that machines nothing: a stop, an optional stop, an operator
message, a work offset change, or raw NC code.

native_ref.description: The source's own reference to its record.

FuzzyTolerance.description: Selection policy for Boolean-operation fuzzy tolerance.

oneOf.description: Let the modeling kernel use its default tolerance.
Determine a suitable tolerance from the participating shapes.
Use the supplied positive model-unit tolerance.

FuzzyTolerance2.description: The Boolean tolerance a feature carries.

oneOf.description: The modeling kernel's default tolerance.
A tolerance determined from the participating shapes.
A stated positive tolerance.

G2BlendConstruction.description: Full native G2 blend construction graph.

G2BlendFirstShape.description: Singularity-specific payload of the first G2 blend side.

oneOf.description: Full singularity with an optional BS3 support surface.

support.description: Exact BS3 support and fit tolerance, when serialized.

oneOf.description: Non-singular nine-scalar frame and tertiary pcurve.

G2BlendFullSupport.description: Exact support surface and fit tolerance of a full G2 first-side shape.

tolerance.description: Fit tolerance of the support, in document length units.

G2BlendSide.description: Common carrier fields of one G2 blend side.

pcurves.description: First and second ordered BS2 pcurves; each may be `nullbs`.

GeneralTolerance.description:
The tolerance of a dimension that states `Tolerance::General`: one rule
in force for lengths and one for angles.

linear.description: The rule for lengths, radii, and diameters.

GeneratedBodyRef.description: Persistent identity of a body in one regenerated feature result.

feature.description: Feature whose regenerated result owns the body.

GeneratedCurveRef.description: Persistent identity of a curve in one regenerated feature result.

feature.description: Feature whose regenerated result owns the curve.

GeneratedEdgeRef.description: Persistent identity of an edge in one regenerated feature result.

feature.description: Feature whose regenerated result owns the edge.

GeneratedFaceRef.description: Persistent identity of a face in one regenerated feature result.

feature.description: Feature whose regenerated result owns the face.

GeneratedFrom.description:
The configuration of another definition that a definition was generated
from.

configuration.description: The factory's configuration the definition was generated from.

definition.description:
The factory definition; `None` only where the member's own record
proves its membership and names no factory.

GeneratedSweepSection.description: Cross-section geometry generated and owned by a sweep construction.

oneOf.description: Filled or hollow circular region centered on the sweep path.

region.description: Outer radius and optional smaller radial wall thickness.

GeneratedVertexRef.description: Persistent identity of a vertex in one regenerated feature result.

feature.description: Feature whose regenerated result owns the vertex.

GenerationRole.description: The role of a generated entity in the feature that produced it.

oneOf.description:
The cap of a swept solid at the end of the span against the sweep's
direction.
The cap of a swept solid along the sweep's direction.
A face swept from a profile entity.
An edge or face that a closed entity closes on.
The body.
A face of a hole, by its place in the hole's shape.

A source role code whose meaning is not established, written
`codec:code`.

Generator.description: The entity that generated a named entity.

oneOf.description: A sketch curve or a sketch point.
A path's spatial-sketch entity.
The entity that this one derives from, by its name.
Straightness.
Flatness.
Roundness or circularity.
Cylindricity.
Coaxiality.
Profile of a line.
Profile of a surface.
Angularity.
Perpendicularity.
Parallelism.
Position.
Concentricity.
Symmetry.
Circular runout.
Total runout.
Source-defined tolerance subtype.

GeometryCombine.description: Whether an operation's geometry replaces or extends its group's.

oneOf.description: Replaces the group's geometry of the role.
Adds to the group's geometry of the role.

GeometryImportFormat.description: External model format consumed by an imported-geometry feature.

oneOf.description: ISO 10303 STEP model data.
IGES model data.
Native boundary-representation model data.

GeometryImportPath.description: A nonempty source path without NUL characters.

GeometryRole.description: The role of an operation's geometry.

oneOf.description: The drive geometry: contours, pockets, faces, holes.
A boundary of the cut.
Geometry the tool avoids.
Picks the operation removes from its drive geometry.
A start point the operation uses.
Geometry that orients the tool.
Geometry that a limit, a height, or a radial base names by `slot`.
A role that no arm states, by the source's name.
One selection per workpiece selected.

Points, each a process construction; a fixed point is a construction
with no inputs.
A direction.
An axis.

Planar geometry the operation owns, as solved curves with no
constraints.

Graft.description:
A replacement of part of a body's boundary by a sheet whose boundary lies
on the body: material is added where the sheet lies outside the body and
removed where it lies inside.

flip.description:
Whether the result's material lies on the side the sheet's normal
points away from, rather than the side it points to.

native_options.description:
Source options whose meaning is not established, and the values of
typed facts whose carrier is unread.

simplify.description: Whether connected faces that share a surface merge.

source_settings.description: Source options with no design meaning.

Grammar.description:
Format-local name of a dialect grammar, for example `sch-sw-33103`.

The namespace is the owning [`DialectMatch`]'s, so a grammar cannot name a
foreign format by construction. The name holds the character class a
[`DialectId`] admits after its separator, which excludes the separator
itself: a full id has no spelling as a grammar name.

Serializes and deserializes as the plain string. `try_from` is the mint, so
no read path reaches the field without the check. serde refuses
`transparent` beside `try_from`; a newtype struct writes its inner string
with no wrapper of its own, which is the same wire form.

oneOf.description:
A group whose values are parameters it owns; an operation value that
inherits one binds it.

A group that holds geometry by role. An operation's geometry for a
role it states no geometry for is its geometry group's, else that
group's parent's.
A group of a kind no arm states, by the source's name.

influence.description: How far along each section's boundary the guide shapes the surface.

tangency.description: How the surface meets the guide.

GuideFrame.description:
The guide vector that `SweepOrientation::Guides` holds at a constant
angle, in each section's plane.

oneOf.description: From the path to the first guide.
From the first guide to the second.

GuideInfluence.description:
How far along each section's boundary, from the point where a guide meets
it, the guide shapes the surface.

oneOf.description: To the next guide.

To the next sharp corner of the section, where two contiguous
entities have no common tangent or equal curvature.
To the end of the section entity the guide meets.
The whole section.

Hand.description:
The turning sense of a helix, a thread, or a tool about its axis
direction.

oneOf.description: Turns by the right-hand rule as it advances along the axis.
Turns opposite to the right-hand rule.

Heal.description: How the gap that deleted faces leave closes.

oneOf.description: Leaves the gap open, so the result is a sheet.
Closes the gap by extending the neighbouring faces.
Closes the gap with one new face bounded by the gap's edges.

tangent.description:
Whether the new face is tangent to each neighbouring face rather
than meeting it with contact.

oneOf.description: A healing whose meaning is not established.

Healing.description:
A deformation of a knit's elements so that gaps up to the knit's tolerance
close. The deformation is the source's, and the result is its evaluation.

frozen.description: The elements that are not deformed.

objective.description: The largest gap the healing leaves.

tangency.description: The largest tangent discontinuity the healing closes.

tangency_objective.description: The largest tangent discontinuity the healing leaves.

Heater.description: A heater of an additive machine.

oneOf.description: An extruder.
The bed.

Height.description:
A height: a reference level plus an offset, along the operation's own
tool axis.

offset.description: The offset from the reference level.

HeightDatum.description: The line a flange's distance height is measured from.

oneOf.description: The intersection of the base's and the flange's inner faces.
The intersection of their outer faces.
The line tangent to the bend and parallel to the flange.

HeightFrom.description: The reference level of a height.

oneOf.description: The work coordinate system's origin: an absolute height.
The stock's top.
The stock's bottom.
The highest point of the setup's model along the tool axis.
The lowest point of the setup's model along the tool axis.
Another height of the same operation.
The `Reference` geometry of the same operation whose slot it names.
The operation's `Machine` geometry.
A reference that no arm states, by the source's mode.

HeightRole.description: The role of an operation's height.

oneOf.description:
